status: Post-hoc evidence synthesis; specification saved before new calculations, after existing point results were inspected. Not preregistered or a fresh holdout.
scope: Annual 1900-2010 verified ProQuest; raw sensitivity only. Historical 250 human-reviewed candidates only. LOC development metrics are separately labeled extraction validation. Modern data and old crisis-window economic analyses excluded.
new_accuracy_check: Recompute fixed saved correctness gaps with equal article weights within each of four topics and all-topic population. 100000 paired occupied calendar-block resamples, lengths 2, 5, 10 anchored 1900. Report marginal 95% and Bonferroni 99.6666667% percentile intervals for 15 contrasts. No p-value inferred from bootstrap tail counts. Conditional on labels and outcomes; dependence/stationarity assumptions remain.
new_verification_check: Three human-reference scenarios: reviewer 1 unclear invalid, reviewer 1 unclear valid, reviewer 2. Two-sided Fisher exact test for human inclusion versus new keep/drop, and exact McNemar for classification-error improvement on same candidates. Six-test Holm family, plus 420-test Bonferroni stress bound (204 prior questions + 210 later diagnostics + these 6 tests). This bound is not a project-wide error guarantee.
verification_uncertainty: 50000 paired article-cluster bootstrap draws stratified by review batch for precision-after minus precision-before, and valid retention. Claims remain paired, one duplicated article kept together. All 2/5/10-year block bootstrap sensitivities anchored 1900 with 20000 draws. Unclear model decision retained. Human reviewers are separate references, not adjudicated gold.
verification_sensitivity: For Fisher test, remove each of the two claims sharing one article in turn as a diagnostic; source claims not deduplicated. Report both. Original 250 sample counts remain primary.
costs: Dated archived LOC cost projections, not current vendor quotes, not ProQuest production costs. No quality equivalence test can be supported by saved aggregate metrics alone.
